author: austinbaustinb
content:
Ok so, first feeding station is done being built and I think I'll hand it off to megan to get painted/finished. Its definitely a prototype but would work. Lots of rough edges, gaps, and some panels just fr didn't update or export right when I got them laser cut, so its a little bit improvised. 
BUT, it is still pretty good quality. 

Prev design is a bit big, I'll call it the "Feeding Station XL". I think this could be neat/useful at larger colonies or areas where we want to give the cats mild shelter. toothless really seems to love the overhang that this has. I can definitely see both eraser and eggs sitting under the roof of this. The 'standing area' is just a bit bigger/not as cramped.
However, if there's just one cat eating at a time, or we aren't really worried about providing extra shade, I am making a second design.

Its not much different, just should be a bit smaller, cheaper, and easier to build. I *think* I might be able to get some big parts of it cut out on one sheet instead of 2, and that really saves us cutting and assembly time.
I attached some photos of the size differences. I have not yet compared the XL to the current stations, but I think it is a bit bigger. The 'bowl holder' area is actually smaller on the XL than on the current stations, but the outward angle makes up for it.

You can see that the newest design really is about as slim as I can make the "bowl holder". The whole thing is smaller in all directions and also should be easier to put together. There were some 'last minute' things I had to change while I was making the XL, so I added those to this.

I will let y'all know a final cost and then will also wrap up the instructions booklet before trying to make the second new station.

If the 'XL' is going to the Fine Arts building, do we currently have a place we're wanting to put a new station in? Like is there one falling apart that we'd want to replace? expand more westward? another at L50? lmk
